body: I watched as the dim lights inside the train flickered weakly, casting eerie shadows on the walls. The air felt colder than usual, thickening around me like an invisible cloud of foreboding. My heart raced faster than ever before, my palms sweating despite my best efforts not to show it. I couldn't help but wonder what had happened, why they were leaving so soon after arriving at their destination. My mind was racing with possibilities—maybe there was something wrong with the train or perhaps someone was sabotaging it... But all these thoughts only served to fuel my growing sense of panic.
